	type = country_event
	title = oe_est2.1.title
	desc = oe_est2.1.desc
	outcome = negative
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_v180_estate_private_levy.dds"

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
			add_estate_private_regiment = {
				estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
				unit_type = unit_type:a_horsemen
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_est2_private_levies_active value = 1 }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_est2.1.a
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
			if = {
				limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
				press_estate_private_regiments = { estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty }
			}
			add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_penalty
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_est2_mod_magnate_banners_pressed years = 12 mode = replace }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_est2.1.b
		ai_chance = { base = 45 }
			add_gold = -50
			if = {
				limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
				add_gold_to_estate = { estate_type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = 50 }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus }
			}
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_est2_mod_warlord_charter_truce years = 15 mode = replace }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_est2.1.c
		ai_chance = { base = 20 }
			if = {
				limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
				clear_estate_private_regiments = { estate = estate_type:nobles_estate }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_severe_penalty }
			}
			add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
			add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
	}
}
